historical_references.reference: Suwaid ibn Ghaflah was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad and one of the ten promised Paradise. He was a leader of the Ansar (Helpers) of Medina and played a key role in the Battle of the Trench (Khandaq) against the Meccan army in 627 CE.
historical_references.context: Early Islamic history, Battle of the Trench

historical_references.reference: The Suwaidi tribe is a sub-tribe of the Bani Asad branch of the Qudha'ah confederacy in the Arabian Peninsula. They are believed to have lived in the region of Al-Ahsa in present-day Saudi Arabia during the pre-Islamic period. The name Suwaidi may have originated from their chief, who was named Suwaid.
historical_references.context: Ancient Arabian tribes, Bani Asad sub-tribe
